decision_question: Under equal concurrent paid Instagram distribution, does showing the verified AED 21,000 price and current availability of the exact Hyundai Elantra GT within the first 1–3 seconds increase unique attributable WhatsApp conversation starts per 1,000 Instagram accounts reached compared with revealing the same facts after 3 seconds?
hypothesis: For UAE used-car buyers comparing affordable available vehicles, immediate verified price-and-availability disclosure will produce at least a 50% higher rate of unique attributable WhatsApp conversation starts than delayed disclosure when audience, distribution, vehicle, message, CTA and all other material variables are controlled.

evidence_basis.finding: The two latest organic Reels recorded 317 views from 103 viewers and 323 views from 112 viewers, while the dashboard reported 98.2% and 91.7% non-follower view shares. Both produced zero profile actions and no attributable conversations. A selected carousel recorded 20 views from 9 viewers with zero engagement or profile actions. These results show that organic discovery beyond the 36 followers exists, but the observed audience and action volume is insufficient for a decision-capable paired lead test.

Four historical promoted campaigns spent between AED 138.84 and AED 176.86 and reported between 6,091 and 12,600 views, demonstrating that bounded paid distribution is operationally feasible. Their 4 to 142 reported in-app conversations are not confirmed as qualified leads or WhatsApp conversations, and campaign objective, audience, content, vehicle and attribution settings are unknown; therefore they cannot serve as a conversion baseline or expected-result forecast.

Relevant UAE dealer funnels repeatedly terminate social attention in a direct WhatsApp conversation or test-drive action. This supports WhatsApp as a commercially relevant destination but does not prove conversion lift for this account.

External observations associate visible price or finance information and stronger first-three-second events with higher content performance, while buyer-signal data shows frequent price and availability questions. The evidence does not isolate a causal effect on qualified conversations, so immediate price-and-availability disclosure remains a hypothesis requiring a controlled test.

audience.need_or_job: Identify an available mass-market used car within a clearly disclosed purchase budget and decide whether to begin a sales conversation
audience.budget_or_payment_context: Verified cash purchase price of AED 21,000; no financing claim
audience.trust_or_risk_concern: Condition, history, warranty and specification concerns may exist, but no response may be claimed without verified business evidence
audience.geography_or_language: The same eligible UAE Instagram audience must be used in both paid variants; language must remain identical
audience.inventory_fit: Verified available Hyundai Elantra GT 2020 currently offered at AED 21,000

mechanism_to_test: Run a simultaneous randomized 50/50 Meta Ads Manager A/B test with Instagram placements only and a click-to-WhatsApp destination. The treatment discloses the verified AED 21,000 price and current availability within the first 1–3 seconds; the control shows the exact vehicle immediately but reveals the identical price and availability only after 3 seconds.
commercial_path: Paid Instagram exposure to a variant-specific WhatsApp conversation about the exact Hyundai Elantra GT, followed by Sales Lead Agent qualification, human appointment or test-drive handling, and exact-vehicle sale attribution.
primary_kpi: Unique directly attributed WhatsApp conversation starts per 1,000 Instagram accounts reached
secondary_kpis: Qualified WhatsApp conversations per 1,000 Instagram accounts reached
Qualified conversations as a share of attributed WhatsApp conversation starts
Outbound or messaging click rate by variant
First-3-second viewing rate, average watch time or completion rate by variant when available
Appointments or test drives attributed to each variant
Sale of the exact vehicle attributed as direct, assisted or unknown
guardrail_metrics: Qualified-conversation share must not be more than 10 percentage points lower for the treatment than for the control
No factual-claim violation or use of an unverified commercial claim
Vehicle remains available throughout the full test window
Both variants use equal audience eligibility, Instagram-only placements, optimization objective, attribution window and delivery rules
WhatsApp links and attribution tokens function correctly before launch and throughout the test
No concurrent campaign targets the same audience with the same vehicle during the test window
baseline: The concurrent delayed-disclosure control arm is the only decision baseline. Recent organic posts establish that current organic action volume is insufficient, while historical promoted campaigns provide distribution-feasibility context only and must not be used as a conversation, qualified-lead or cost baseline.
success_threshold: After the minimum sample and complete window, the treatment produces a WhatsApp conversation-start rate per 1,000 Instagram accounts reached at least 1.5 times the control rate and at least 5 additional unique attributed conversation starts, while the qualified-conversation share is no more than 10 percentage points lower and no factual, tracking, availability or distribution guardrail fails.
failure_threshold: After the minimum sample and complete window, the treatment produces a WhatsApp conversation-start rate per 1,000 Instagram accounts reached no greater than 0.8 times the control rate and at least 3 fewer unique attributed conversation starts, with valid execution, attribution and no fatal confounder.
minimum_sample: At least 5,000 Instagram accounts reached per variant, at least 40 unique directly attributed WhatsApp conversation starts across both variants, and at least 10 such starts in each variant. If any requirement is unmet when the fixed window or approved spend cap ends, the result is INCONCLUSIVE.
test_window: Run both variants concurrently for 7 complete days using randomized 50/50 allocation and judge the result once after the fixed window closes. Do not stop early for apparent performance unless a factual, tracking, availability or operational guardrail fails.
variable_being_tested: Timing of verified price and availability disclosure: within the first 1–3 seconds versus after 3 seconds.
controlled_variables: All other verified vehicle facts and forbidden unverified claims
Base execution after the opening treatment
Total duration and pacing after the opening
CTA wording, placement, objective and WhatsApp destination
Instagram-only placements with Facebook placement excluded
Equal 50/50 budget allocation and delivery rules
execution_constraints: Do not hand the experiment to Content Analyst until a human approves the paid-test budget and launch conditions.
The proposed hard budget cap is AED 400 total, allocated as AED 200 per variant, with no automatic top-up.
The AED 400 cap is a bounded feasibility proposal informed only by historical spend ranges; it does not guarantee that the minimum sample will be reached.
Use Meta Ads Manager randomized A/B testing rather than publishing the variants seven days apart.
Use Instagram placements only; Facebook views or delivery must not enter the decision denominator.
Use one common base execution and change only the declared disclosure timing.
Do not claim condition, accident or ownership history, service history, warranty, financing, discount, exact trim, rarity or specific-instance advantages.
Create functionally equivalent variant-specific WhatsApp links or prefilled attribution tokens tied to experiment ID, experiment version, variant and ad or publication ID.
Record ad IDs, timestamps, allocation, spend, reach, delivery settings, vehicle ID and attribution tokens before measurement.
Sales Lead Agent must record source token, exact vehicle, qualification result, appointment or test-drive outcome and sale outcome.
If the vehicle becomes unavailable, tracking fails, delivery is materially unequal or settings differ outside the tested variable, stop and classify the test as INCONCLUSIVE.
If the human rejects the paid budget, one organic execution may be used only as an end-to-end instrumentation and baseline run; it must not be used to decide which opening wins.
attribution_method: Use separate functionally equivalent click-to-WhatsApp links or prefilled source tokens for treatment and control, joined to experiment_id, experiment_version, variant, ad_id and vehicle_id. Sales Lead Agent records each unique conversation start, qualification outcome, appointment or test drive and exact-vehicle sale. Report attribution as direct deterministic, assisted or unknown; do not infer qualification from Meta's historical in-app conversation totals.

decision_rule.continue: Continue only until the fixed 7-day window closes or a fatal guardrail requires stopping. If the approved spend cap or window ends before the minimum sample, return INCONCLUSIVE rather than extend or top up the test without a new human decision.
decision_rule.iterate: If both variants generate adequate reach but insufficient WhatsApp starts, or starts are adequate but qualification is weak, preserve this opening result as inconclusive and create a separate one-variable experiment for the diagnosed downstream conversion bottleneck. If a bounded execution defect invalidates the comparison, correct that defect in a new version without changing other variables.
decision_rule.scale: If the success threshold is met without guardrail failure, approve one confirmation replication on another comparable available mass-market vehicle before adopting the immediate-disclosure mechanism as a playbook standard.
decision_rule.kill: If the failure threshold is met with complete valid execution and attribution, reject immediate price-and-availability disclosure as the preferred opening treatment for this context. If neither success nor failure threshold is met, or the minimum sample is missing, classify the result as INCONCLUSIVE rather than kill the hypothesis.
